description: This file defines the `ProductDescription` class, a JPA entity representing product description details in an e-commerce application, including metadata and related product information.

classes.name: ProductDescription
classes.description: A JPA entity class that models product description details, including metadata, highlights, and external links associated with a product.

methods.name: getProductExternalDl
methods.description: Returns the external download link for the product.

methods.name: setProductExternalDl
methods.description: Sets the external download link for the product.

methods.name: getSeUrl
methods.description: Returns the search engine friendly URL for the product.

methods.name: setSeUrl
methods.description: Sets the search engine friendly URL for the product.

methods.name: getMetatagTitle
methods.description: Returns the meta title tag for the product.

methods.name: setMetatagTitle
methods.description: Sets the meta title tag for the product.

methods.name: getMetatagKeywords
methods.description: Returns the meta keywords tag for the product.

methods.name: setMetatagKeywords
methods.description: Sets the meta keywords tag for the product.

methods.name: getMetatagDescription
methods.description: Returns the meta description tag for the product.

methods.name: setMetatagDescription
methods.description: Sets the meta description tag for the product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product object with this description.
